purpose: Reader-focused quality introduction and simplified factual project status; design examples, not production screenshots

prompts.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram, product introduction illustration for Chinese NocoBase Studio quality documentation. Produce a clean, very simple flat vector-style explanatory graphic on a white background, about 1600×800 landscape. This is NOT an application screenshot. No sidebar, no navigation, no dashboard. Large legible Simplified Chinese text, black/gray labels, restrained cobalt-blue accents and very pale blue group backgrounds, thin rounded outlines, simple line icons. No gradients, 3D shapes, dense paragraphs, scores, percentages, numbers, detailed workflows or tiny footnotes.

Explain only this product concept: development delivers many requirements; Studio supplies professional built-in quality-assurance capabilities; users get tested functionality, readable reports and tracked issues. Professional Skills support the testing methods.

Arrange THREE visual groups from left to right, connected by simple blue arrows:
LEFT group title “开发交付”, with a modest stack of three small task cards labelled “新功能”, “功能改进”, “缺陷修复”. Subtle checkmark icons show tasks being delivered; a couple of empty outline cards behind suggest continuing work.
MIDDLE, largest group, title “Studio 内置测试能力”. Inside this group two clean subpanels:
“业务测试” containing three short separate labels “整体质量摸底”, “每日测试”, “发布测试”;
“专题测试” containing short labels “安全”, “性能”, “权限”, “UX”, “浏览器兼容”.
A small simple shared strip at the bottom of the middle group reads “专业测试 Skills”, visually supporting both subpanels. No implementation details.
RIGHT group title “质量结果”, with three short output items and small line icons: “功能检查结果”, “测试报告”, “问题跟进”.
Optionally one understated return arrow from 问题跟进 towards 开发交付 along the bottom, labelled “修复与回归”. Keep the graphic airy and easy to understand.
Do not include custom plans or custom testing; those will be explained at the end of the article. Do not write a big marketing headline or repeat long prose from the article. Use only the exact short labels listed. This introductory diagram should convey capabilities at a glance.
